IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every mutation of the ontology, entity, relationship, command, interaction and operations APIs. A repeat with the same body replays the stored result; the same key with a different body is 409 idempotency_mismatch.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

DerivedSummaryOut.description: Graphiti's running summary of an entity. DERIVED text: it is never a fact source, never used to answer a question, and always labelled so.
DerivedSummaryOut.title: DerivedSummaryOut

EntityRefIn.description: An endpoint: by platform id, or by a strong external identifier (never by name, KGR-02).
EntityRefIn.title: EntityRefIn

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every non-2xx response. `details` never echoes request values (field paths only).
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

EvidenceOut.description: Why the system holds a fact (KGR-05): a command, or an episode of an interaction. Never content.
EvidenceOut.title: EvidenceOut

ExternalRef.description: A strong external identifier, resolved at acceptance when possible and otherwise kept UNRESOLVED for P4 identity resolution.
ExternalRef.title: ExternalRef

InteractionIn.description: Validation is per FIELD (not a whole-model check) so every error names its path; `details.fields` never carries a value.
InteractionIn.title: InteractionIn

InteractionRef.description: An interaction behind a review item. The reviewer reads its content through the audited evidence endpoint, never from this list.
InteractionRef.title: InteractionRef

ReviewEntityView.description: One side of an identity comparison. Sensitive attributes are redacted unless the caller may see them.
ReviewEntityView.title: ReviewEntityView

info.description: Versioned /v1 API. Every route declares an authorization policy; errors use one envelope.
info.title: Knowledge & Memory Platform API
